"Caveats filed by Tata Sons Pvt Ltd in Bombay High Court and Supreme Court in relation to order dated 27 Nov 2026," as per a person in the know. The two Tata trusts can move the courts in appeal, and the caveats will help Tata Sons present their side in the matter. items.title: FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri again after Bengal sample fails
items.rss_summary: Food regulator FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International after a packaged drinking water sample collected from its West Bengal plant failed laboratory testing, sources said. The sample tested positive for coliform bacteria, they added. This form of bacteria can enter water systems through sewage leaks or damaged pipes, among other pathways. This action marks the second instance of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) sanctioning prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd, a leading player in the packaged drinking water sector in the country. On Sunday, the FSSAI announced similar legal proceedings after a sample from one of Bisleri's plants in Goa also failed testing. The West Bengal sample was taken from a plant in Jalpaiguri's Telipara village. The presence of coliform bacteria was confirmed by both primary and referral laboratories. Jalpaiguri ke Telipara plant se liye gaye iss sample mein coliform bacteria paya gaya hai, jo primary aur referral labs dono mein confirm hua. FSSAI ne batch number PB 201 ki sale par rok laga di hai. Isse pehle Goa plant ke sample fail hone par bhi FSSAI ne aisi hi karyavahi ki thi.

items.title: Adani Group eyes airline investments months after ruling out airline entry
items.rss_summary: The diversified Adani group, which runs multiple airports across the country, has requested the government to allow it to invest in the airline sector, a top official said on Friday. Group chief finance officer Jugeshinder Robbie Singh told reporters that over 60 crore people in the country can fly, and the number of daily flights needs to go up by nearly 10 times to 30,000. "And that's why we requested the government to at least allow us to invest, so that we can facilitate the development of airlines. Some fund, some other airline company and things like that...or an entrepreneur who wants to go into that space," the CFO said while speaking on the sidelines of the India Debt Capital Market Summit here. In July this year, the group said it was "not evaluating any proposal to enter the airlines business".
